summary: Root cause: commit 634d93b (wires_to on record_decision) appended an edge_added event without the actor field that graph-store appendEvent requires, so record_decision with wires_to threw. Fixed by defaulting actor to b.actor || 'record-decision' in daemon.js; daemon restarted, verified end-to-end (note note-mqacbw9tv85 created with wires_to). Commit 2f3a2e1, pushed.

subject: Fix record_decision "event.actor is required" daemon error
description: The record-decision handler at daemon.js:~2247 calls graph-store appendEvent without the required actor field. Find why, fix, restart daemon, verify with a real record_decision call.
